package_claims_verified: Counts verified by direct inspection of the extracted ZIP's catalog/*.json: 66 screens, 340 panels, 41 forms, 284 fields, 170 actions, 1270 test_cases, 36 journeys, 280 api_contracts. All match the delivery's own stated numbers exactly.
scope_reality: 66 screens across 4 interfaces is far larger than any single session can implement with this build's own standing practice (real tests, load-bearing verification of every safety-critical invariant) in one pass. Building incrementally, screen-by-screen / phase-by-phase, exactly as every other phase in this project has been built -- never claiming a screen is done until it has real DB-backed queries/commands and real passing tests.

fifth_slice.real_bug_found_and_fixed_along_the_way: Adding release_reviews to app/db.py's _TENANT_SCOPED_TABLES broke the EARLIER 04c418cbb547 migration on a fresh `alembic upgrade head` replay -- that migration calls the shared _apply_row_level_security helper with no args, which read the CURRENT (now-grown) tuple including a table that didn't exist yet at that point in migration history. Fixed by giving _apply_row_level_security an explicit `tables` parameter and pinning 04c418cbb547 to its own frozen snapshot of the 6 tables that actually existed then, rather than the live, ever-growing module constant. Caught by actually replaying the full migration chain against a disposable cluster, not by reasoning about it.
